system.description:
Heraldry is the skill of recognizing and deciphering heraldic coats of arms. Medieval family crests exist in a bewildering array of iterations and combinations, and the herald’s knowledge of them is encyclopedic.

Obstacles: Common/prominent family, Ob 1. Second tier families, Ob 2. Lesser known cousins, Ob 3. Dead lines or remote branches, Ob 4. Obscure houses, Ob 5.

FoRKs: Etiquette

Skill Type: Special. Tools: No.

Root: Perception

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 277
